text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx rate for /v1/generate (us-west-2) — error rate 6.8% over 5m. Pager: PD#7890. Automatic reroute: standby model activated.

Samir Patel: taking pager, connecting to bridge.

Jess Liu: on bridge. tagging @Maria for customer impact.

Maria Gomez: FYI support: several mid-market customers reported timeouts; CS notified. Customer A had ~30% requests failing, we're tracking.

Samir Patel: quick check: rolling deploy completed 18m ago. I'm checking autoscaler, logs.

Samir Patel:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime
# pod runtime-5 crashed with OOMKilled
```

Kevin Hart: saw eviction events on node gpu-7, kernel OOM in dmesg.

Olivia Chen: We had a KV cache invalidation earlier, might be related — cache thundering on cold restart.

Jess Liu: Mitigation: scaled up dedicated pool by +2 instances, enabled fallback routing to model v1-quant, and rolled restarts on the hot pods.

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://oncall.redwood/bridge/incident-7890

Samir Patel: Confirming error rate dropping to ~1.1% after fallback. Latency stable. Still need a full postmortem.

Maria Gomez: Customer impact summary: Customer A experienced 22m of elevated failures, several timeouts for sync calls; Customer B had intermittent errors (5–10m windows). CS opened tickets.

Jess Liu: Scheduling postmortem: propose Thursday 10:00 PT. Who can own tech analysis?

Kevin Hart: I'll take ownership for root-cause analysis and action items.

Olivia Chen: I'll take alert tuning + SLO followups (reduce paging noise, set burn-in windows).

Samir Patel: Action items (assign owners):
- RDW-2345: rewrite /v1/generate paging thresholds + alert doc (Kevin)
- RDW-2346: autoscaler policy audit + ramp tests (Samir)
- RDW-2347: KV cache guardrails and cold-start mitigation (Olivia)
- RDW-2348: customer comms and timeline (Maria)

Jess Liu: Add evals: synthetic load that reproduces KV cache invalidation + fallback correctness.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft customer communication and loop in CS leadership.

Samir Patel: Handoff: I'm on until 23:00 PT then handing to @Kevin — will update bridge before leaving.

Kevin Hart: ACK. Will monitor and update tickets.

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 1862346078 (downtime window ~22m). Postmortem tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-INC-7890

Jess Liu: Quick follow-ups we should consider: convert noisy 4xx/non-critical alerts to non-pageable, add 5m burn-in for new deploys, and ensure fallback model routing is exercised in CI.

Olivia Chen: I'll open a PR in infra/alerting with proposed threshold changes and link RDW-2345.

Maria Gomez: Postmortem meeting scheduled: Thu Mar 20 10:00 PT — invite sent. Please add any pre-reads to the PM doc.

Samir Patel: Thanks all for quick response. Great handoff and clear action items. :thumbsup:
